name: williams_r_reversion_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, algorithmic momentum flows periodically push the index to the extreme of its 3-minute high-low range — Williams %R below -88 — accompanied by an elevated volume ratio, signaling a climax bar where aggressive sellers have cleared the near-side order book. At this point, passive buy orders resting below market begin absorbing remaining supply, and delta-neutral market makers short gamma (from ATM option selling) start hedging by buying NIFTY futures, creating a swift reversion toward mid-range. At 5-second resolution we capture the first 30-90 seconds of this rebound as Williams %R turns back from -90 toward -50, before the move dissipates into the session equilibrium. The VWAP proximity filter ensures we avoid entering during sustained institutional directional TWAP flows where the extreme can persist.

indicators.name: williams_r_36
indicators.purpose: 36 bars = 3 minutes. NOT 12x blind scaling — original 20-min lookback on 1-min bars cannot be directly scaled (that would give 240 bars = 20 min, far too long for a 15-90s hold). We hold 15-90 seconds and enter at the TURNING POINT from extreme, so the detection window must be tight: a 3-minute extreme on NIFTY (~15-30 spot pt range) is still actionable at 30-90s because the reversion from range extreme is fast. A 20-min extreme would require much larger deviations and much longer holds to mean-revert.

indicators.name: vol_ratio_24
indicators.purpose: 24 bars = 2-minute rolling average volume denominator. Detects climax/capitulation volume at the Williams %R extreme. 2-min window avoids over-averaging (which would dilute genuine spikes) while providing a reliable session baseline. Threshold reduced from original 2.0x to 1.5x because NIFTY index volume is inherently smoother than individual stocks — a 1.5x ratio on NIFTY is genuinely significant.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative(typical_price * volume) / cumulative(volume) from 09:15 IST each day
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP as a proximity filter. No lookback scaling needed — VWAP is always cumulative from 09:15. Only trade Williams %R extremes that occur within ±1.5% of VWAP. In sustained NIFTY trending sessions (driven by FII directional flows), Williams %R can stay in extreme territory for minutes — the VWAP filter avoids these false reversals.

indicators.name: wr_slope_3
indicators.purpose: 3-bar (15-second) Williams %R slope confirms the turn is already underway. Avoids entering at a falling knife: we require %R to be rising (for buy CE) or falling (for buy PE) over the last 15 seconds. This is retained directly from the original strategy's wr_slope logic but compressed from 3 bars on 1-min (3 minutes) to 3 bars on 5s (15 seconds) because at this granularity, a 15-second turn is already a confirming signal.

conditions: close > vwap * 0.985 (within 1.5% of VWAP — not in runaway NIFTY downtrend)
vix_close < 25 (normal volatility regime; high VIX means extremes can persist)
wr_slope_3 > 0 (Williams %R already turning up from extreme over last 15s)
consecutive bars in extreme < 5 (not stuck trending — filtered out)
buy_ce.confirmation: close >= open on the entry bar (NIFTY closing above the bar open = immediate buy-side pressure absorbing the extreme)

conditions: close < vwap * 1.015 (within 1.5% of VWAP — not in runaway NIFTY uptrend)
wr_slope_3 < 0 (Williams %R already turning down from extreme over last 15s)
buy_pe.confirmation: close <= open on the entry bar (NIFTY closing at or below bar open = immediate sell-side pressure at the extreme)

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 NIFTY spot pts at ATM delta ~0.5. If a 3-min range extreme fails to trigger reversion within 15-30 seconds, NIFTY is likely continuing its trend and the thesis is wrong. NIFTY's typical 90s move is 3-7 option pts, so 4 pts provides adequate room for the bounce to develop. A 5-pt option adverse move equates to ~10 spot pts beyond the extreme — at that level the 3-min range has been decisively broken.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts = ~14 NIFTY spot pts. A 3-minute Williams %R range on NIFTY is typically 20-35 spot pts; reverting from the extreme (WR ~-90) to mid-range (WR ~-50) covers roughly 50% of that range = 10-17 spot pts → 5-8 option pts at delta 0.5. 7 pts captures the median reversion leg with a 1:1.75 risk-reward ratio.

filters.vix_filter: VIX < 25 — in high-VIX regimes, NIFTY range extremes driven by macro fear can persist rather than revert
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST — skip first 2 minutes of opening noise; stop new entries before EOD flatten
filters.volume_filter: vol_ratio_24 > 1.5 — essential signal quality gate; a drift to range extreme without volume surge is likely a slow trend, not a capitulation
filters.trend_filter: close within ±1.5% of VWAP — avoids counter-trend entries during sustained NIFTY institutional TWAP flows
filters.spread_filter: N/A — limit orders on index options at 5-second bar close

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — Williams %R extremes with volume spikes are less crowded than RSI/Stochastic on NIFTY, but the mean reversion thesis shares mechanism with oscillator-based strategies

adaptation_notes: Original trades NIFTY200 stocks on 1-min bars with 20-bar Williams %R (20 min). Key changes: (1) Lookback compressed from 20 min (240 bars) to 3 min (36 bars) — we hold 15-90s, not 5-20 min; catching the fast initial bounce requires a tighter range window. (2) Volume spike threshold lowered from 2.0x to 1.5x — NIFTY index volume is smoother than individual stocks; a 1.5x ratio is meaningfully elevated for the index. (3) VWAP proximity widened from ±1% to ±1.5% — index is less prone to single-stock gaps but can trend further from VWAP during FII flows. (4) Williams %R slope confirmation compressed from 3-bar 1-min (3 min) to 3-bar 5s (15s) — at 5s resolution a 15s turn-up is already a valid confirmation. (5) Eliminated stock-specific filters (earnings, ADV, stock bid-ask spread). (6) Added 'not stuck in extreme >5 bars' filter to avoid false reversals in trending NIFTY sessions.
weaknesses: Williams %R is unsmoothed — at 5-second bars, a single large NIFTY candle can temporarily spike WR to extreme without genuine exhaustion
NIFTY volume data at 5s is noisy; vol_ratio_24 threshold may need per-session calibration for monthly expiry / RBI / FED event days
Mean reversion fails in strong trending regimes (FII net buying/selling days, global risk events), which are exactly the sessions that generate the most signals
